EDTA Disodium.safety_reason: Edetate disodium is a metal-chelating agent. FDA has never approved any chelation product for over-the-counter use for any health condition, and medically used chelation agents require prescription supervision. A standalone product sold to be swallowed as a chelator is therefore not an ordinary dietary supplement and receives no PharmaGuide quality score. This is a non-routine-use policy determination: it is not a finding that the labelled oral dose is proven acutely toxic, and the disodium and calcium disodium forms are distinct identities with different clinical uses.
